summary: One or two days to answer is seen as reasonable if the candidate has what they need.
realLife: A career guide says one to two days is fair when you already have the information, three to five days is standard with competing factors, and a week or more is likely too long unless another offer is pending.
sources: Duke University career blog, how to evaluate a job offer and ask for time: https://careerhub.students.duke.edu/blog/2024/11/01/how-to-evaluate-a-job-offer-and-ask-for-time-to-think-about-it/
inGame: Needs: an offer record with a deadline; the deadline slot can be filled by a short span on the employer's job-offer call.
